_doc: The seat runtime's inference ladder — sealed decision c8572a92's sibling, pair 3613d55e (seat-runtime-provider-ladder-2026-09-20).
Data, not code: a rung is (provider, dialect, base_url, key_env, models, budget, issued). Free tiers first, Ollama floor, Anthropic by task class.
A 429 / quota / timeout on one rung steps to the next in the class's ladder; every wake inks provider+model+rung+tokens so 'cheapest-capable' is measured, not assumed.
Keys are NAMES here, never values. Values live only in $WILLOW_HOME/env on the host (Kart's kart_env prefix list) — this file must never hold one.
Free-tier limits move; `budget` is what the operator believed at `verify_at`, and the ladder should refuse to trust a rung whose verify_at is older than rotate_after_days.
status: unmeasured until the first wake inks a receipt on that rung; the steward tick may flip it to measured/degraded from receipts.

Every rung a class names must carry a models.<class> entry; ratatosk.ladder refuses the file otherwise (a rung with no model for the class could never be tried, and a silent skip would hide the hole).

_classes_doc: Order within a class is the fall-through order. 'audit' keeps a cross-model rung above the builder's ladder on purpose: an audit on the same free 70b that built the thing is not an audit.
Names match dispatch task_class / the envelope task classes (build-work-order -> build, auditor -> audit, librarian -> research, operator -> operate, witness -> witness).
xAI/Grok is not a rung: console.x.ai went paid (operator, 2026-09-20).
